programme.title: Dr. Nou

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S3/E1'. Drie deelnemers probeer mekaar nie net met hul algemene kennis uitoorlê nie, maar ook met hul kennis van mense. Die een wat sy teenstanders die beste opsom en met die regte vrae teiken, kan met groot geld wegstap.

programme.title: Ons Gesels Balans
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Dit kan moeilik wees om balans te vind wanneer jou huishouding uitbrei. Hierdie week kom kuier my vriendin Kara du Toit, aktrise en nuwe mamma, by my. Ons gesels oor hoe om balans te vind as jong ma en deel praktiese wenke.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Emily Blunt'. Ina is joined by friend Emily Blunt for a day of cooking and conversation. Ina welcomes her guest with classic English cream scones and Emily makes turkey Bolognese.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Nathan Lane'. Nathan Lane spends a day at Ina's barn, where she makes Nathan's favourite dessert, rum raisin rice pudding, and he shares his incredible life story.

programme.title: Be My Guest with Ina Garten
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Marcus Samuelsson'. Ina greets her neighbour, Marcus Samuelsson, with a delicious French 75 Cocktail. Marcus shares the story of his childhood journey from Ethiopia to become a culinary superstar.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S21/E5 - All Un-Gredients'. Guy challenges the chefs to make family favourite dishes without using the key ingredients. Which competitor will win a shopping spree worth up to $20,000?

programme.desc: 'S28/E16 - Fusion Of Flavors'. Guy digs into a range of flavour fusions, from a Latin-Asian mashup in Chicago with paella and posole to a Hawaiian spot serving guava ribs and tropical pizza.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S28/E17 - Tasty Traditions'. Guy Fieri dives into dishes steeped in tradition. He checks out Russian piroshki in Seattle, and a hidden joint serving Hawaiian food to a Jewish deli in Chicago.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S2/E12 - Take Me To The Tropics'. The chefs are challenged to whisk the judges away to somewhere sweet with tropical desserts. The first basket includes an island cocktail.

programme.desc: 'S37/E11 - Dumpling-icious'. Guy Fieri visits a Japanese joint in Cincinnati that serves meaty gyozas. Then, a Nepalese spot in Oregon showcases their traditional fare.

programme.title: Zoe Bakes
